# synology_ddns_record (Resource)

A DSM DDNS provider record. Existing records require import; Create rejects collisions. Credentials are write-only and versioned. Synology/TWNIC hostname registration, certificate issuance and account enrollment remain separate DSM workflows; their existing records can be imported but not renamed here. Automatic address observations are not equivalent to published DNS success. Deletion is protected by default and can affect external DNS registration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "ddns_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "synology_ddns_record" "nas" {
  provider_id         = "ExampleDNS"
  hostname            = "nas.example.invalid"
  username            = "example-account"
  password_wo         = var.ddns_password
  password_version    = 1
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) DSM DDNS provider identifier, from the discovered provider catalogue. DSM supports one configured record per provider.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse record deletion by default. Disabling this explicitly permits DSM record deletion and possible external unregistration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable DDNS updates. New records require true; omission preserves existing policy.
- `heartbeat` (Boolean) DSM DDNS heartbeat policy.
- `hostname` (String) Registered hostname. Required for creation; changing Synology/TWNIC registration is refused.
- `ipv4_address` (String) IPv4 address. Configure explicitly only with ipv4_interface = an empty string for a manual address. Automatic addresses are observed when omitted.
- `ipv4_interface` (String) default for public-address discovery, disabled, an existing interface name, or an empty string for an explicit manual address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address. Configure explicitly only with ipv6_interface = an empty string for a manual address. Omission preserves automatic observations.
- `ipv6_interface` (String) default, disabled, an existing interface name, or an empty string for a manual IPv6 address.
- `password_version` (Number) Monotonically increasing credential generation. Zero preserves imported credentials. External credential drift is unreadable.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) DDNS password or authentication key. Required for generic-provider creation and for an increased password_version. Never stored in plan or state.
- `username` (String) DDNS account username. An intentional username change requires an increased password generation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DSM record identity. Import the ID from data.synology_ddns.records.
- `network_mode` (String) Observed DSM address-selection mode, derived from the selected interfaces when writing.
- `reconciliation_required` (Boolean) An ambiguous write requires DSM inspection and explicit release/import before further mutations.
- `status` (String) Observed DSM update status. The resource owns configuration, not DNS propagation.
